title: One timeline. Two storage tiers.
description: Keep recent footage close and older recordings on your NAS, without changing how you watch.
loadFailed: Storage health could not be loaded. Check the connection and your administrator permissions.
saveFailed: Storage settings could not be saved. Check the connection and try again.
saveConflict: An edited storage setting changed elsewhere. Discard your draft, review the latest settings, and try again.
usageUnavailable: Storage usage could not be refreshed. Last successful values are shown when available.
usageStale: Storage usage is still being sampled or is out of date. Do not treat these values as current.
refreshFailed: The latest storage status could not be refreshed. Reload the page to confirm the saved settings.
saved: Saved. Storage settings will apply live; no Frigate restart is needed.
pending: Settings are saved and waiting for the archive worker to acknowledge them. A stalled NFS operation must return before the worker can apply changes. Archive location remains locked until it acknowledges the latest settings.

capacity.protectedIncluded: Protected footage is included in content usage, not additional usage. Its separate size is unknown.
capacity.maintenanceUnknown: Maintenance holds durable reservations. Allocated staging bytes are not yet known, so incoming physical headroom is unavailable until maintenance completes.
capacity.shared: These tiers share a mounted filesystem. Their physical totals and available space are not additive; moving between them does not free physical space.
capacity.filesystemHint: Values describe the mounted filesystem or NFS export, not raw NAS disk capacity or a specific Unraid SSD pool. Separate mounts may share a provider capacity pool; do not add their reported totals.

progress.title: Buffered archive transfer
progress.buffering: Buffering locally until the start threshold

triggers.high_water: Triggered by the configured local archive start threshold.
triggers.local_pressure: Triggered early by the estimated two-hour local free-space reserve.

phases.verification: Reading back and verifying the archive copy
phases.commit: Committing verified media and its playback location
phases.waiting: Waiting for eligible segments or archive capacity

progress.fileBytes: Copied {{copied}}; read back {{verified}} of {{size}}. Readback is not committed until verification succeeds.
progress.batch: Committed after verification: {{moved}}, {{files}} files. Initial plan: about {{planned}}, {{plannedFiles}} files.
progress.initialPlanHint: The initial plan is fixed and uses indexed size estimates. Completing it does not finish the drain if new footage keeps arriving.
progress.live: Additional net incoming: {{incoming}}. Local usage {{usage}}, stop target {{target}}, remaining drain {{remaining}}.
progress.aggregateCopyRate: Aggregate copy throughput: {{rate}} (current parallel batch average).
progress.aggregateVerificationRate: Aggregate archive readback throughput: {{rate}} (current parallel batch average).
progress.measuring: Throughput and ETA need at least two committed files and a valid recording-rate sample.
progress.buffer: Estimated time to the start threshold: {{time}}.
progress.cannotOutpace: The measured transfer rate is not exceeding ingest. The drain target cannot currently be reached at these rates.

retention.title: Effective video retention
retention.explanation: Camera values below include inherited defaults and camera overrides. Continuous capture must be enabled to preserve quiet footage. Archive retention extends stored footage, but cannot recreate missing recordings. Protected footage, capacity cleanup, and emergency deletion can affect actual availability.
retention.global: Global continuous: {{continuous}} days; motion: {{motion}} days; archive minimum: {{archive}} days.
retention.maximum: An explicit archive age cap of {{days}} days may shorten longer camera policies, except for protected or leased footage.

cameras.empty: No cameras or retained recordings are available.
cameras.unavailable: Per-camera storage information is not available from this backend.
cameras.caption: The summary graph, Other, Unused, and filesystem percentages describe local storage only. Camera-cell bars show each camera's share of known recording usage in that location. Recording totals can lag by up to one minute.
cameras.incomplete_one: Size is unknown for {{count}} recording segment; shown usage is incomplete.
cameras.incomplete_other: Size is unknown for {{count}} recording segments; shown usage is incomplete.

local.title: Local recordings
local.target: Move oldest first, draining to {{percent}}% of the budget.

archive.title: NAS archive
archive.retention: {{days}} days from recording time, or longer when camera retention requires it
archive.maxAge: Maximum capture age: {{days}} days, except protected or leased footage

blocked: Incoming archive transfers are paused or the archive is not responding. Protected or leased footage can prevent age or capacity cleanup, including when existing protected content exceeds the budget. Check the status code, NFS mount, identity marker, permissions, space, and archive logs. Emergency local deletion remains independent and may occur if enabled.

thresholds.title: Local archive start and stop
thresholds.hint: The left handle stops transfers; the right handle starts them. The scale runs from zero to your local recording budget. Saving these thresholds does not change retention or enable deletion. Low physical free space can trigger transfers earlier.
thresholds.summary: Start archiving at {{start}}% of the budget; drain to {{stop}}%.
thresholds.invalid: The stop threshold must be lower than the start threshold.
thresholds.upgrade: Separate archive start and stop thresholds require an updated backend.

fields.enabled: Move older recordings to the archive
fields.max_age_days: Maximum archive age (days, blank = no cap)
fields.max_archive_gib: Maximum archive content (GiB, blank = no cap)

liveHint: Storage controls apply without restarting cameras or detection.
mountHint: Provision the NFS mount and its .frigate-archive identity file before enabling. Location and identity are locked while archiving is enabled or archived recordings exist. Turning archiving off stops new moves; existing archives still expire by retention.
emergencyHint: When less than one estimated hour of free space remains, reclaim ordinary local footage first and unsaved event footage only as a last resort. Protected footage is never automatically deleted. Recording may stop if no eligible space can be reclaimed.
retentionHint: Archiving preserves footage selected by existing recording modes; it does not enable continuous recording automatically. Retention is measured from capture, never from transfer. Reducing it can permanently delete older footage.
limitsHint: 6144 GiB equals 6 TiB. Archive capacity counts exact recording file bytes plus incoming reservations, not total NAS usage or filesystem overhead. Maximum age overrides longer camera retention. Expire oldest explicitly permits early deletion of ordinary footage, then unsaved events only as a last resort. Saved evidence and active original-media leases are exempt; if cleanup cannot make room, transfers pause. Leave limits blank to preserve existing retention.

fullBehavior.expire_oldest: Expire oldest eligible footage (unsaved events last)

confirmRetention: I understand that reducing age or capacity limits, or enabling oldest-first eviction, can permanently delete unprotected recordings before minimum retention.

restart.title: What applies live?
restart.live: Storage budget, drain target, transfer limit, archive retention, and emergency policy apply live. Recording retention updates now reach both cleanup and storage maintenance.
restart.process: Other settings keep their existing per-field restart guidance. Model/device changes and process-level settings are not made restart-free by this feature.
restart.mount: Adding or changing a Docker volume mount requires recreating the container. Once mounted, editing these storage controls does not.
